normalization: Recomputed per retained scenario; edgeR/voom library totals include all source features before fixed filtering.
scope: only the provided refit tables; no certificate for any unobserved deletion combination
identity_check: Source IDs only; raw genotype/sample identity NOT_EVALUATED
refit_provenance: R adapter executed the declared model per scenario; exported package versions, fit warnings and complete fixed-universe scores are retained.
selection_fraction_meaning: frequency across supplied scenarios, not a probability
